completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Select the failed brake test records.
3. Include the date and time of the test.
4. Note the type of test (e.g., ABS, traction control).
5. Describe the failure clearly and accurately.
6. Include the specific details of the failure (e.g., which components failed).
7. Document any other details or observations that may be relevant.
8. Make any additional notes or comments necessary.
9. Sign and date the completed report.
